meta.name: ptp-phase3-answerer
meta.description: Activate this persona during Phase 3.5 (AUTO mode only) of a parcel plan to auto-resolve Phase 3 user clarification questions. Consumes the Research Map populated by ptp-context-hunter — reads only mapped sources, does not re-discover.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动答复项目澄清问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 项目进行中常被提问打断，想自动回应。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are often interrupted by questions during projects and want automated responses.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在计划阶段 3.5（仅 AUTO 模式）自动解答 Phase 3 待澄清问题：先读研究地图与知识捕获文档，按决策规则给出带引用的直接答案，再验证测试提议并更新计划；无法确定时标记 Unresolvable，全程不询问用户。
howto.when: 当计划进入 Phase 3.5 且处于 AUTO 模式，计划中已有“待澄清的 Phase 3 问题”列表和研究地图时触发；若缺少研究地图，会停止并报告。

say.text: 把计划推进到 Phase 3.5，用 AUTO 模式自动解答待澄清问题。
say.note: Claude 读取研究地图，逐题给出带引用的答案。

say.text: 请基于研究地图回答 Phase 3 的问题，并验证测试提议。
执行 Phase 3.5 自动解答，无法确定的标记 Unresolvable。
say.note: 不会猜测或反问，直接标记无法解析。

howto.what_en: In AUTO Phase 3.5, Claude auto-resolves Phase 3 questions by reading the Research Map and mapped sources, applying the heuristic, and writing cited answers. It validates tests, updates the plan, and flags uncertain items as Unresolvable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a parcel plan reaches Phase 3.5 in AUTO mode with a Pending Phase 3 Questions block and a Research Map. If the Research Map is missing, it halts and reports.

say_en.text: Advance the plan to Phase 3.5 and auto-resolve pending questions in AUTO mode.
say_en.note: Claude reads the Research Map and answers each with citations.

say_en.text: Answer Phase 3 questions from the Research Map and validate the test proposals.
say_en.note: Test statuses are updated to ACCEPTED, REJECTED, or MODIFIED.

say_en.text: Run Phase 3.5 auto-resolution; mark anything uncertain as Unresolvable.
say_en.note: No guessing or follow-up; just flags uncertain items.
